title: White House forms 'Transportation Technology Transformation Tiger Team' to prevent further air traffic control outages
date_note: Anadolu's page, published 23 November, gives no earlier day for its report of the team's daily meetings; CBS News reported the team's formation on 16 November.
summary: Anadolu Agency reports that the White House has formed a special team, with officials from the FAA, Transportation, Defense and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, to prevent further air traffic control outages ahead of Thanksgiving. A White House official told Anadolu the FAA is examining "near-term network configuration options". Anadolu says officials insist the earlier nationwide halt was not the result of a cyberattack.
plain: The White House has set up a special team with the FAA and other agencies to prevent more air traffic control outages before Thanksgiving, Anadolu reports. Officials insist the earlier halt was not a cyberattack.
exec: Anadolu reports a White House team is working with the FAA to prevent further air traffic control outages ahead of Thanksgiving travel.

validation.note: Anadolu Agency (via Hurriyet Daily News) and CBS News each state that the White House formed the team with FAA, DOT, Defense and ODNI officials; both rely on White House or unnamed US officials, so status stays developing. No White House or FAA page was read.

review.note: Compared team members, near-term network configuration quote, officials' no-cyberattack statement, dates with Anadolu/Hurriyet and CBS
